description_en: Submits a refund application for an international flight ticket
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen intl-flight-refund-apply --out-refund-apply-id 202503251022170001 --refund-reason-code 0 --passenger-journey-group-key edcac4f4c79d40ccb141ddb6da567e65 --refund-segment-list segment_key=CZ5009PKXHKG0616 --selected-passengers full_name=ZHANG/SAN passenger_id=1000001 --order-id 1002145190081005400 --out-order-id 3750656668336001024 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IntlFlightRefundApply

parameters.help_en: The refund group key returned by the consultation operation
parameters.help_zh: 咨询接口返回的退票分组key
parameters.name: passenger_journey_group_key

element_fields.help_en: The unique key of the segment. Format: flight number + departure airport + arrival airport + departure date (MMdd)
element_fields.help_zh: 航段唯一key，组成格式:航班号+出发机场+达到机场+起飞日期（MMdd）
element_fields.name: segment_key

parameters.help_en: The list of flight segments to be refunded
parameters.help_zh: 选择要退票的航段列表
parameters.name: refund_segment_list

element_fields.help_en: The full name of the passenger
element_fields.name: full_name

parameters.help_en: The list of passengers to be refunded. Either the passenger ID or the passenger full name is required
parameters.help_zh: 选择要改签的乘机人列表，乘机人id和乘机人姓名二选一必传
parameters.name: selected_passengers

parameters.help_en: The business travel order ID. This parameter is required
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The external order ID. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: out_order_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

- When calling this operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the token, see [Enterprise access token](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
- When appending the token, use crop_token=value instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

- 通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：[企业访问凭证](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)。
- 在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
